Acceptance.description: The authoring form of the Completion Contract's closed typed AST (ADR-0010).
Acceptance.title: Acceptance

AuthSelection.description:
The authentication/billing route a node runs under; a profile reference, never a
credential. Local CLI sign-in, API credentials and provider cloud accounts are distinct
routes resolved by the deployment registry (SPEC-02 "Authentication").
AuthSelection.title: AuthSelection

CapabilityKind.description: Catalog Capability Kinds a manifest entry may name (ADR-0020, ADR-0023).
CapabilityKind.title: CapabilityKind

CapabilityReference.description: A pin-or-search entry with no kind-specific fields (skills, plugins, models).
CapabilityReference.title: CapabilityReference

ChainLinkDeclaration.description:
Shape of one ``links`` entry; graph and binding semantics live in
``domain/composition/chain.py`` (SPEC-04).
ChainLinkDeclaration.title: ChainLinkDeclaration

ConflictPolicy.description: How a repository entry and a Mission Control entry with the same key resolve.
ConflictPolicy.title: ConflictPolicy

ContextEntry.description: A read-only context item: a catalog entry, an artifact, or a workspace path.
ContextEntry.title: ContextEntry

ContinuationPolicy.description:
Context pressure policy: soft/hard watermarks, native compaction preference and the
sealed-checkpoint fallback (SPEC-01 "Four independent progress mechanisms"). The
defaults are qualification tuning inputs, not provider guarantees.
ContinuationPolicy.title: ContinuationPolicy

ControlsV2.description: ``mission/v2`` controls: v1 controls plus watchers and consumed notifications.
ControlsV2.title: ControlsV2

Enforcement.description: Required unmet blocks; expected unmet is a visible shortfall; optional absence is silent.
Enforcement.title: Enforcement

Environment.description:
Lane, model, sandbox, workspace, capabilities and limits; every field is optional so a
node can overlay any subset. A mission-level Environment must be complete (see
:func:`resolve_environments`).
Environment.title: Environment

EnvironmentSecret.description: A secret by name and broker reference; the value never enters the manifest.
EnvironmentSecret.title: EnvironmentSecret

EnvironmentV2.description:
A v1 Environment plus the multi-provider selections and the environment additions.
Every field stays optional so a node can overlay any subset; the v2 lane rules apply to
the effective environment.
EnvironmentV2.title: EnvironmentV2

EnvironmentVariable.description: A non-secret variable: an inline ``value`` or a ``config:`` installation reference.
EnvironmentVariable.title: EnvironmentVariable

ExecutionEnvironmentSelection.description:
``local_workspace`` (a worker-hosted profile) or ``provider_hosted`` (a published
provider cloud environment). ``provider`` must match the lane; a local ``path`` is
invalid for hosted work (SPEC-02).
ExecutionEnvironmentSelection.title: ExecutionEnvironmentSelection

ExportDeclaration.description:
OVE-176 (OUTPUT-CONTRACTS §9): how a nested body exports one declared output of its node.

Every declared output of a nested Goal Loop or Stage Graph is exported to the parent (final by
default). ``from: <stage>.<output>`` names the inner producer of a Stage Graph body's output;
``timing: early`` lets an independently accepted output leave an incomplete composite without
accepting it. Undeclared inner outputs never cross the boundary.
ExportDeclaration.title: ExportDeclaration

FactDeclaration.description: A typed fact the host reads at ``pointer`` of this node's accepted structured output.
FactDeclaration.title: FactDeclaration

KitSelection.description: The Environment Kit a lane materializes: an exact catalog pin, digest required.
KitSelection.title: KitSelection

LaneProfile.description:
The one Lane Profile vocabulary (MP-01): runtime (`domain/execution/lanes.py`),
frames, the manifest ``lane`` field and the common SQL CHECKs derive from or are checked
against it. ``claude_cloud``/``codex_cloud`` are the provider-hosted products only;
``claude_managed``/``codex_agents`` are the API-billed hosted agent APIs (ADR-0050).
LaneProfile.title: LaneProfile

MaterializationPolicy.description:
The manifest's ``materialization`` block. ``conflicts`` absent: ``refuse`` for
permission and hook conflicts, ``repo_wins`` for the rest; a declared value applies to
every category.
MaterializationPolicy.title: MaterializationPolicy

MissionBlockV2.description:
A v1 mission block with v2 Environments and its Data Class. Lanes that are not
ZDR-eligible admit a mission only by its declared class; a mission without one is
refused there (``domain/execution/data_class.py``), never assumed harmless. Its controls
add watchers and consumed notifications (SPEC-04 §5, :mod:`mission_watchers`).
MissionBlockV2.title: MissionBlockV2

NetworkPolicy.description:
The declared egress policy. ``include_kit`` adds the kit's required egress and
``include_signal_ingress`` the Mission Control ingress host (SPEC-04).

A node overlay merges into the inherited policy, so cross-field rules are validation
issues on the effective environment (:func:`environment_lane_issues`), not shape errors.
NetworkPolicy.title: NetworkPolicy

NotificationsDeclaration.description:
``mission/v2`` ``controls.notifications``: notify-only watchers on public event types
or significance kinds, delivered to the coordinator inbox.
NotificationsDeclaration.title: NotificationsDeclaration

OutputCoverage.description: The exact promised subjects a structured output must cover (never a bare count).
OutputCoverage.title: OutputCoverage

OutputDeclaration.description: One exact named output promise (OUTPUT-CONTRACTS §2): form, enforcement, coverage.
OutputDeclaration.title: OutputDeclaration

OutputMembers.description: Nested guarantees of an index: every exact member it lists must pass these checks.
OutputMembers.title: OutputMembers

OutputRequirementDeclaration.description: A promised guarantee proven by an independent assessment (a declared check).
OutputRequirementDeclaration.title: OutputRequirementDeclaration

ProviderEnvironmentStrategy.description: How a provider-hosted lane gets its base layer (SPEC-01 §7).
ProviderEnvironmentStrategy.title: ProviderEnvironmentStrategy

ReleaseGroupDeclaration.title: ReleaseGroupDeclaration

ReleaseGroupMember.description: One exact group member and the subjects its output covers (for coverage).
ReleaseGroupMember.title: ReleaseGroupMember

RequiredFeatures.description:
What the workflow needs the lane to actually provide. Admission intersects these
with the lane's describe (:mod:`domain.execution.lane_requirements`); a required feature
the lane cannot provide is a pointed error, never a silent fallback (V01).
RequiredFeatures.title: RequiredFeatures

RevisitDeclaration.description:
A bounded Revisit Region (01-STAGE_GRAPH §8): a known stage set with a declared entry
and exit, a hard visit cap (counting the first visit) and a deterministic stop: ``until``
facts when authored, else fulfillment of every required obligation the region owes. An
integer ``progress`` fact with ``patience`` ends a region that stops improving. ``carry``
names exit outputs the next visit's entry receives (the prior visit's accepted revision).
RevisitDeclaration.title: RevisitDeclaration

RouteDeclaration.description:
An explicit conditional route: ``all_matching`` or ordered ``first_match`` (required; no
silent universal choice). ``else`` releases only when every branch is conclusively false.
RouteDeclaration.title: RouteDeclaration

RoutePredicateDeclaration.description: ``<stage>.<fact> <op> <value>``: a closed typed comparison over a pinned stage fact.
RoutePredicateDeclaration.title: RoutePredicateDeclaration

SubscriptionDeclarationV2.description:
A ``mission/v2`` subscription: ``stream`` or a signed webhook. ``mcp`` was never
delivered (no MCP session registers a manifest subscription), so v2 rejects it; agents
wait on their coordinator inbox instead (ADR-0049).
SubscriptionDeclarationV2.title: SubscriptionDeclarationV2

WatcherActionSpec.description: One ``then`` entry: exactly one typed action, each mapped to an existing path.
WatcherActionSpec.title: WatcherActionSpec

WatcherDeclaration.description:
One ``controls.watchers`` entry: an inline :class:`WatcherSpec` or a catalog ``pin``.

A pinned watcher takes its body from the published ``mc.watcher.v1`` template; the entry
may only narrow its ``limits`` and set ``until``.
WatcherDeclaration.title: WatcherDeclaration

WatcherTriggerSpec.description: ``on``: exactly one trigger; ``where`` filters a fact trigger, ``while`` gates on the run.
WatcherTriggerSpec.title: WatcherTriggerSpec

WorkspacePolicy.description:
Mission Control allocates the workspace; the agent does not choose whether isolation
exists (SPEC-02 "Worktrees and snapshots").
WorkspacePolicy.title: WorkspacePolicy

description: ``mc.mission_manifest.v2``: one mission or a chain, with v2 Environments.
title: Mission Manifest v2
